source_row.rationale: Terbutaline is a beta-agonist and can cause maternal tachycardia, arrhythmias, pulmonary edema, myocardial ischemia, hypokalemia, and hyperglycemia. It is not FDA-approved for prolonged tocolysis beyond 48–72 hours and must not be used for outpatient maintenance tocolysis. New cardiovascular or respiratory symptoms require urgent review.
